Coppergate Ceramics

Coppergate Ceramics is a small pottery in York making wheel-thrown stoneware tableware for home cooks and independent restaurants. Every piece is thrown, glazed and fired in the Walmgate studio.

Shop the collection

What we make

We make six ranges of stoneware: dinner plates, side plates, bowls, mugs, jugs and serving dishes. Prices run from £18 for a mug to £96 for a large serving dish.

How pieces are made

Each piece is thrown by hand on the wheel, dried for 5 days, bisque fired to 1000C, glazed by dipping, and fired again to 1260C. A single mug takes 14 days start to finish.

Where to find us

The studio and shop are at 41 Walmgate, York, YO1 9TT. We open Thursday to Sunday, 10:00 to 17:00. Call 01904 555 812.

Commissions

We take restaurant commissions from 40 pieces upwards, quoted at £22 to £70 per piece depending on form and glaze. Lead time is 8 to 12 weeks.
